item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Chicken Danoise with white potatoes, cream sauce and green peas tossed in browned butter and parsley. Served with rhubarb compote and pickled cucumber. (6)
